_comment: Only a boar leads a wild pig herd. The game gives only the males a runtime spawn chance, so the females fall back to the default chance of 1, and every spawner pass started sow-only groups that filled the pig cap before a boar's 0.03% chance came up: islands full of sows and no boars or piglets. Deer list "*": 0 for this; pigs and sheep do not. Sows and piglets still spawn as the boar's companions.
The same for sheep: only a ram leads a flock.
